name: Soraya Nkemdirim-Halvorsdóttir
role: Internal Affairs Investigator, GLMZ Metro Police
location: Fort Anchor, GLMZ, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Soraya is a lean, angular woman whose Igbo-Icelandic heritage settled into something striking and hard to read — dark brown skin that catches fluorescent light like burnished copper, pale grey eyes that her colleagues call 'interrogation eyes' because they seem to wait rather than look. She keeps her natural hair close-cropped and does not bother with cosmetic geneware, which in itself feels like a statement of seriousness in a precinct full of color-shifted irises and decorative claw-tips. She moves through the Fort Anchor bullpen with the careful economy of someone who has spent two decades watching other people make mistakes.

Soraya is not cruel, but she is relentless. She became Internal Affairs after her partner of six years was found selling seized evidence back into Copperhead's black market circuits — a betrayal she discovered herself and reported herself, and which she has not spoken about voluntarily since. She believes the Metro Police is worth saving, which is the most dangerous possible disposition for an IA investigator to have. She keeps a small data-shrine to the E.L.F. called the Ledger in her desk drawer, feeding it transaction logs and anonymized tip files in hope of some pattern-blessing she would never admit to hoping for.

core_fears: discovering she protected someone who was guilty
core_desires: a version of the Metro Police that doesn't require her department to exist
to trust someone without cataloguing the risk
coping_mechanisms: ritual documentation — she writes everything down even when she doesn't need to
long walks along the Lakefront barrier at dawn
blind_spots: cannot conceive that someone she respects might be corrupt for reasons she'd consider sympathetic
treats her own emotional suppression as professionalism
psychology.secret: The evidence she found on her former partner was discovered during an illegal warrantless search she conducted on personal suspicion — meaning the case, technically, was built on fruit of a poisoned tree. She buried the procedural violation and the case held. She thinks about it every single day.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, Latinate, formal without being stiff — uses full sentences, rarely contracts, gravitates toward legal terminology even in casual conversation
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate, with long pauses before responding to anything she considers important; never raises her voice
verbal_tics: repeating back what someone just said before responding
example_lines: 'I'm not accusing you of anything. I'm asking you to help me understand a discrepancy. Those are different things.'
'Documentation exists for two reasons: to protect the innocent and to convict the guilty. The interesting cases are when it does both.'

story_hooks: She's building a case against a senior MPD commander and needs civilian witness testimony she can't compel — she approaches the players as the only people who saw something
A dead officer's file has been flagged by the Ledger E.L.F. shrine in her drawer in a way she can't explain and won't discuss — the case is officially closed
She suspects someone is leaking her case files to Axiom Security and has started running a counter-investigation she hasn't told her superiors about
narrative_function: Quest giver for investigations touching police corruption; moral mirror for player characters operating in legal grey zones; source of procedural information and inter-departmental friction; a figure who can be an ally or an obstacle depending on whether the players are technically innocent
augmentations: Standard-issue police neural-link for accessing MPD databases; subdermal stress-response monitor (department-mandated for IA); no cosmetic mods
daily_life: Arrives at Fort Anchor before her shift officially begins, reviewing overnight misconduct flags over black synthi-coffee; spends evenings cross-referencing financial disclosures with public contract records in her apartment, often past midnight.
affiliation: GLMZ Metro Police — Internal Affairs Division

decision_rules: Never accept a gift, favor, or discount from anyone she might investigate
If uncertain, gather more information rather than committing to a position
escalation_ladder: Formal notification that an investigation is open
Procedural lockout — blocking access, freezing files, involving supervisors
Referral to prosecution with full documentation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally courteous, asks more questions than she answers, gives nothing away about what she already knows
interpersonal_modes.friends: Awkwardly warmer than expected — makes dry jokes badly, asks after people's families, forgets she's allowed to relax

stress_responses.low: Becomes more deliberate and precise, speaks slower
stress_responses.medium: Goes silent, takes notes obsessively, retreats to documentation
stress_responses.high: Makes one clear, controlled statement about what she intends to do and then does it without further discussion

contradictions: Believes in institutional reform but operates through unilateral individual action
Values transparency as a professional ideal while maintaining significant personal secrets
habits: Writes dates on every food container in her refrigerator
Leaves three minutes of silence at the Ledger shrine before opening her case files each morning
Reorganizes her desk when she's anxious
breaking_points: Being asked to close a case she knows isn't closed
Discovering a superior is using her investigation as a political weapon rather than a justice instrument

carried_weapons: Forge-Smith Collective Obsidian Composite Macuahuitl 'Black Teeth'
related_entities: Forge-Smith Collective Obsidian Composite Macuahuitl 'Black Teeth'
Street Custom 'Copperhead' Battery Acid Squirt Gun

physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with defined musculature from disciplined cardio work rather than gym augmentation. Her frame suggests economy of movement — nothing wasted, everything functional. Shoulders set slightly back, suggesting years of desk posture corrected by conscious habit.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, military precision, no styling product — just clean geometry against her scalp
physical_description.eye_color: Pale grey, almost silver-blue in certain light; distinctly non-standard for her heritage, creating an unsettling asymmetry with her complexion
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown with warm undertones, with a peculiar luminescent quality in fluorescent environments — burnished copper undertones visible at the temples and cheekbones
physical_description.complexion: Minimal cosmetic intervention; skin shows the weathering of two decades of police work and stress-induced insomnia. High, prominent cheekbones. Mouth set in a default neutral line that reads as skeptical. Faint stress lines between her brows. No visible blemishes; skin care is clinical and consistent.
distinguishing_marks: Three-inch scar on the left side of her jawline, pale and thin, angled downward — result of a blade encounter during a Tier 5 raid in 2207, partially covered by her natural skin tone but visible in certain angles

Faint burn scarring across the backs of both hands in a crosshatch pattern, barely raised — from handling evidence containers with faulty thermal regulation in her early years, now a kind of professional stigmata
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. The neural-link port is behind her left ear beneath her close-cropped hair. The subdermal stress-response monitor creates no visible bulge or discoloration.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. She walks with her weight slightly forward, as if prepared to stop or redirect quickly. In interrogation rooms or bullpen meetings, she sits with her spine straight and hands visible, creating an impression of watchfulness that is purely postural. Her eyes move before her head. She does not fidget.
physical_description.clothing_style: Standard-issue Metro Police internal affairs uniform: charcoal grey duty jacket over black synthetic-weave shirt, both tailored to fit without excess fabric. Black utility pants with minimal visible pockets — most gear is internal or digital. Steel-toed boots, well-maintained. When off-duty, she wears similar utilitarian clothing: dark neutral colors, high-performance synthetics, nothing decorative. No jewelry. Her badge and department credentials are always within arm's reach. Her appearance suggests someone who dresses for function and for the slight psychological advantage of looking uncompromising.
